response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Accounts a JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), sh AS (SELECT st, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM s), av AS (SELECT st, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_account_base, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_over_average_share FROM av WHERE share > avg_share
